_comment: H-axis (§4quater header/footer position-collision) capture definitions for capture-driver.js. fixtureDoc = table-header.docx (top body table = table 1 / collision; bottom body table = table 2 / immune). md follows the same conventions as the T-goldens: plain text for intra-cell, [CELL:r,c] markers for whole/partial tables, [TABLE:i]...[/TABLE]\n\ntext for table<->paragraph crossings.

cases.note: top-of-body table entire (collision). Expect: clone [[w,x],[y,z]] AFTER the table (like T3). §4quater deferred: insert-after-top-table may land far -> xfail.
in-place replace of the top table (like T3).
top table last cell -> following paragraph (like T5, table->para crossing).
replace the cell + following paragraph in place.
intra one cell (0,0) -> paragraph path (like T1).
partial multi-cell (top row) -> reduced copy after table (like T2a).
bottom (immune) table entire -> must behave like a normal T3 (regression guard).
in-place replace of the immune bottom table (like T3).
